QuestInfo.name: [Ellin Forest] Child of Destiny
QuestInfo.0: Talk to #bSion#k, who is taking care of the baby in the #bTent House#k, and help her out.
QuestInfo.1:
Sion said the baby has a fever and asked that you bring her #bFever Medicine#k.
Go to #bLoha#k in #bAltaire Camp#k and ask for the Fever Medicine.
QuestInfo.2:
You brought the Fever Medicine, but #bCrawls with Balrog#k overcame the fever by himself.
Perzen said this child will #bshoulder the future#k. Is he destined for greatness someday?

default.0: You haven't gone yet? Please ask #bLoha#k in #bAltaire Camp#k for the Fever Medicine. This is urgent!
